title: The Four Lanterns
author: unknown Starwright hand
pages: Should the Bound one fall and the Night rise, this is the way of rekindling. It was written so it need never be done twice. Read it knowing that it is being read because it was.
Take the Last Ember to the rim where she fell, where the exit-gate stands on its pillar of old stone. Raise four Lanterns about the gate, one to each wind, as the Binding host did.
A Lantern is made of a seeking eye, the tears of the Underfire's weepers, and clear glass to hold them. It is a vessel. Know what vessels are for.
When the four are lit, the Ember wakes, the light returns and takes a shape, and it is bound again. The Night will recede as the tide does, slowly, leaving wreckage behind.
There is a price. The Lanterns are never truly fed by glass. Someone who loves the world gives to them. We gave ourselves. Do not ask who will give this time. You will know. It will be done.
